# Components

Find a component in the tables below, then open its page for examples and props. Installation, `ThemeProvider` and theming are described in the [README](../../README.md).

## Guides

Read these before writing a page: they explain how the components are meant to be combined.

- [Building pages](guides/building-pages.md): How to build a page with vellum-ui: compose the page from components and set only semantic props, never styles; pick the component for each need from one table; start from one of the page skeletons; give every state (loading, empty, error, submitting, destructive actions) the component made for it, without flashing; write text, numbers and times the same way everywhere; and check the page against the list at the end before committing it.
- [Conventions](guides/conventions.md): The API conventions of vellum-ui that hold for every component: sizes, tones and variants; native attributes; values and change callbacks; how "no value", dates, times, decimals and colors are written; open state; native attributes, refs and test ids; the texts of the library; and a table of the Ant Design habits that do not work here, with what to write instead. Read it before writing code: the props are the library's own, not antd's, even where a component is implemented with antd.
- [Custom styles](guides/custom-styles.md): When an application may write its own CSS next to vellum-ui, and the rules for it: only business-specific visuals that no component covers; design tokens through `var(--vl-…)` for every color, size, radius, shadow and duration; pixel literals limited to `0` and `1px`; no inline `style`; the shared state layer (`data-vl-state`) for custom elements that can be clicked; entrance motion with the library's global keyframes; and the neutral viewer tokens behind images.

## Recipes

Complete pages built only from the components, ready to copy and adapt.

- [Chat page](recipes/ChatPage.md): A full-screen chat without Page: a flush SplitView with the conversations on the left, and a MessageList with PromptInput on the right.
- [Dashboard](recipes/Dashboard.md): A Page with a time range in the toolbar, a row of Statistic tiles in a Grid, and charts below: a LineChart, a BarChart, a DonutChart and a SegmentedBar.
- [Detail page](recipes/DetailPage.md): The title and actions of one record, with a "More" menu; its fields in Descriptions, a meter in a Panel, and Tabs whose content loads on its own.
- [Form dialog](recipes/FormDialog.md): A primary action opens a Modal with a Form: required fields, an email rule, an asynchronous check, a date and a hint.
- [List page](recipes/ListPage.md): A page with a title, a primary action, a search and a filter in the toolbar, and a DataTable with pagination, selection and bulk actions; loading, empty and error states.
- [Master-detail page](recipes/MasterDetail.md): A SplitView: a searchable list of ListItem on the left, the details of the selected item on the right, each side scrolling on its own.
- [Settings page](recipes/SettingsPage.md): A narrow page of Sections and Panels with SettingRow: switches that take effect immediately (and roll back when saving fails), and a group of InputNumber and Select saved with one button, with a message as feedback; a danger zone at the end.

## Primitives

| Component | Description | Common uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Box](components/Box.md) | A general-purpose container whose padding, surface, radius and border all come from tokens. | Local background blocks, scrollable areas, padding around a group of content |
| [Center](components/Center.md) | Centers its content horizontally and vertically in the available space. | Empty states, loading indicators and placeholder notes for a whole page or area |
| [Divider](components/Divider.md) | A divider that separates content at the same level, optionally with text (such as date separators in a message list). | Date separators in message lists, groups in menus and lists |
| [Grid](components/Grid.md) | Arranges children in a grid, with a fixed number of columns or filled automatically by a minimum column width. | Card grids, grids of entry points on a home page, two- or three-column forms |
| [Inline](components/Inline.md) | Lays out children horizontally, vertically centered by default. | Buttons, tags, icons and text side by side; with a Spacer, pushing the rest to the right |
| [Spacer](components/Spacer.md) | Flexible space that fills the remaining space in an Inline or Stack and pushes the following elements to the other end. | Pushing the action buttons of a toolbar to the right |
| [Stack](components/Stack.md) | Lays out children vertically, with spacing from the token steps. | Stacking blocks, form fields and lists vertically; replaces hand-written layout classes and layout CSS |
| [Text](components/Text.md) | Text with consistent font size, weight, tone, monospace and truncation. | Secondary text, IDs and paths (`mono`), amounts and times (`numeric`), truncation, group headings (`overline`) |

## Basic

| Component | Description | Common uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [AutoComplete](components/AutoComplete.md) | AutoComplete is a text input that suggests values while typing; unlike Select, any text can be entered. | Email addresses and domains, tags, search with suggestions |
| [Avatar](components/Avatar.md) | A letter avatar showing the first character of a name. | Avatars of conversations, teams and projects; `leading` of list items; account menus; online status |
| [Breadcrumb](components/Breadcrumb.md) | Breadcrumb shows where the current page is in the hierarchy and links to its parent pages. | Folder paths, the parent pages of a detail page, settings subpages |
| [Button](components/Button.md) | Buttons trigger an action. | Primary action of a page header, form submission, confirming a dialog |
| [Cascader](components/Cascader.md) | Cascader picks a value from options nested in several levels, such as region → city → district or category → subcategory; each level opens in its own column. | Regions and addresses, nested categories, choosing a folder by path |
| [Checkbox](components/Checkbox.md) | Checkbox for multiple choices, or a single yes/no choice such as "Also delete the data". | Boolean form fields, permission checkboxes, bulk selection |
| [ColorPicker](components/ColorPicker.md) | ColorPicker picks a color in a panel (saturation area, hue and alpha, a text field in HEX, RGB or HSB) and shows it in a swatch; `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from, and `showText` shows the value next to the swatch. | Label and tag colors, brand colors in settings, annotation colors |
| [ContextMenu](components/ContextMenu.md) | A context menu: wraps any content and opens a menu of actions on right click, `Shift+F10` or the menu key, at the pointer or next to the focused element. | Actions on list rows, files, images and messages, in the habits of desktop applications |
| [CopyButton](components/CopyButton.md) | A button that copies a text to the clipboard. | Copying tokens, links, IDs and code examples |
| [CountBadge](components/CountBadge.md) | A count badge: a pill with tabular numbers. | Unread counts of conversations, to-do counts, team sizes, number of entries in a group |
| [DatePicker](components/DatePicker.md) | Date picker: picks a date (with a time when `showTime` is set, or a month with `picker="month"`). | Date filters, due dates, start dates |
| [Dropdown](components/Dropdown.md) | Dropdown menu: a list of actions (`menu.items`) that opens when the trigger is clicked or hovered. | "More" actions in a row, account menus, theme switching, several options for creating something |
| [Form](components/Form.md) | Collects, validates and submits data. | Create and edit dialogs, settings pages, sign-in |
| [Heading](components/Heading.md) | A heading whose font, weight and letter spacing come from tokens. | Titles in dialogs, drawers and custom areas |
| [Icon](components/Icon.md) | A line icon (Lucide), referenced by name, with a consistent stroke width. | Icons in buttons, list items, menus and empty states; the `icon` field of menu items uses the same names |
| [IconButton](components/IconButton.md) | A square icon button with a transparent background, a tooltip and an accessible name. | Secondary actions in toolbars and list items (refresh, more, download, close); accent style for Send |
| [Input](components/Input.md) | Single-line text input. | Form fields, search fields in toolbars, entering a name in a dialog |
| [InputNumber](components/InputNumber.md) | Numeric input with step buttons and tabular numbers. | Numeric settings such as days, time limits, quantities and sort order |
| [Kbd](components/Kbd.md) | Key caps that show a keyboard shortcut, such as `<Kbd keys={['Mod', 'K']} />`: ⌘ K on macOS, Ctrl K on other platforms. | Shortcut hints in menus, tooltips, command palettes and shortcut help; key hints at the bottom of overlays |
| [LinkButton](components/LinkButton.md) | A text link button: accent-colored text without background or underline, with the font size of its context. | Edit, archive and remove in table rows; clickable names in lists; "View" and "Pin" on cards |

## Charts

| Component | Description | Common uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [AreaChart](components/AreaChart.md) | Area chart: a line chart whose areas are filled with a light wash (about 10% opacity). | Volume over time (storage used, requests per hour), parts of a total over time (stacked) |
| [BarChart](components/BarChart.md) | Bar chart: compares values across categories, as grouped or stacked columns, or as horizontal bars. | Comparing amounts across categories (sales per region), ranked lists (horizontal, largest first), parts of a total over time (stacked) |
| [ChartContainer](components/ChartContainer.md) | A card for a chart: title, description, actions, legend, the graphic and its states. | Wrapping a custom graphic (a map, a diagram) so that it matches the other charts of a dashboard |
| [DonutChart](components/DonutChart.md) | Donut chart: a pie chart drawn as a ring. | The same uses as PieChart, when a ring fits the layout better |
| [Heatmap](components/Heatmap.md) | Heatmap: values over two sets of categories (such as weekdays and hours), colored on a sequential scale for magnitude or a diverging scale around a midpoint. | Activity by weekday and hour, change compared with a target by team and month (diverging) |
| [LineChart](components/LineChart.md) | Line chart: one or more series over ordered categories, usually time. | Trends over time (revenue per month, active users per day), comparing a few series over the same period |
| [PieChart](components/PieChart.md) | Pie chart: one whole split into a few parts (at most 6 by default; the rest is folded into "Other"). | A rough split of one whole into a few parts (storage by file type, traffic by source) |
| [ScatterChart](components/ScatterChart.md) | Scatter chart: the relation between two values, one point per item. | Correlation between two measures (price and sales, size and duration), spotting outliers |
| [SegmentedBar](components/SegmentedBar.md) | A segmented bar shows how one whole splits into a few parts (up to 6 by default), as blocks whose widths are proportional to the amounts. | Storage by file type, time spent per phase, budget split, the split of a figure in a table row |
| [Sparkline](components/Sparkline.md) | A sparkline: a small trend line without axes, for stat tiles and table cells. | Trends in stat tiles, a trend column in tables, activity over the last weeks in list items |
| [Statistic](components/Statistic.md) | A stat tile: a label, a value, its change compared with an earlier period, and an optional trend line. | KPI rows at the top of dashboards, key numbers of a project or a period, figures next to a chart |

## AI

| Component | Description | Common uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Citation](components/Citation.md) | An inline citation marker, such as a superscript 1 after a sentence, that shows its source on hover or focus. | Numbered citations in AI answers, footnote-style references in generated text |
| [Markdown](components/Markdown.md) | Renders Markdown written by an AI, also while it streams in. | AI replies, streamed answers, generated summaries and documentation |
| [Message](components/Message.md) | One message of a conversation. | Messages of an AI chat, replies with copy and retry, failed or stopped generations |
| [MessageActions](components/MessageActions.md) | Actions under a message: copy, retry, like and dislike, plus your own icon buttons. | Copy, retry and rate an AI reply; actions of a chat message |
| [MessageList](components/MessageList.md) | A virtualized list of messages that stays at the latest message: only the visible messages are rendered (the number of DOM nodes does not depend on the number of messages, and heights can vary), and new messages or a reply that is still growing keep the view at the end. | AI chat conversations, long chat histories with earlier messages loaded on scroll |
| [PromptInput](components/PromptInput.md) | The text field of a chat: it grows with its text, sends with `Enter` and turns its send button into a stop button while a reply is generated. | The message field of an AI chat, prompts with attachments, any field that sends with Enter |
| [PromptSuggestions](components/PromptSuggestions.md) | A set of suggested prompts, each with a label and an optional description and icon; choosing one calls `onSelect`. | Starter prompts of an empty chat, follow-up questions after a reply |
| [Reasoning](components/Reasoning.md) | The reasoning of an AI model before its answer: a header that shows whether it is still thinking or how long it took, and the reasoning text, which can be expanded and collapsed. | The thinking of reasoning models before an answer, the plan of an agent |
| [Sources](components/Sources.md) | The sources of an AI reply: collapsed to "3 sources" at first, and a numbered list with the title, the site and a short description of each when expanded. | Sources under an AI answer, search results that back a reply, the documents behind a summary |
| [StreamingText](components/StreamingText.md) | Plain text that is typed out while it streams in: new text is revealed at a steady pace that follows the arrival of the chunks, instead of appearing in blocks. | Streaming plain-text replies, generated titles and summaries, live transcripts |
| [ToolCalls](components/ToolCalls.md) | A list of tool calls or steps of an AI agent, each with its state, and its input and output that can be expanded. | Tool calls of an agent (search, file reads, API calls), multi-step tasks, background jobs of an assistant |
| [useStream](components/useStream.md) | Runs a streaming request and accumulates its chunks into a value, such as the text of an AI reply. | Streaming AI replies, long-running generation with a stop button, any `text/event-stream` endpoint |

| Component | Description | Common uses |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Alert](components/Alert.md) | An alert for persistent information on a page or in an area that needs the user's attention (warnings, limits, next steps); `tone` sets the meaning. | Reminders that a feature is not configured, secrets shown only once, notes in a danger zone |
| [App](components/App.md) | Root component of the application: provides the context for messages (useMessage) and danger confirmations (useConfirmDanger), so that they use the current theme. | Root component of the application; wrap standalone pages or tests that need messages or confirmations |
| [Drawer](components/Drawer.md) | Drawer that slides in from the right, for viewing details or editing longer content without leaving the current page. | Details and editing that keep the context of a list, such as member details, permission settings or conversation settings |
| [EmptyState](components/EmptyState.md) | Empty state: an icon or illustration, an explanation and a call to action. | Empty lists, searches without results, nothing selected in a split view, features not configured yet |
| [ErrorState](components/ErrorState.md) | Error state: shown instead of the content when loading fails, with the reason and a way to retry. | Failed requests for a list or details, lost connection to a service, missing permissions |
| [Loading](components/Loading.md) | Loading indicator: a centered spinner. | Short loading inside drawers, dialogs and panels |
| [Modal](components/Modal.md) | Dialog for a short task that needs the user's full attention (create, edit, confirm). | Create and edit forms, confirmations, command palettes |
| [PageSkeleton](components/PageSkeleton.md) | Page skeleton: replaces the whole page while its data loads for the first time; its shape is close to the final page, which reduces layout shifts. | First load of list pages, detail pages and split view pages |
| [Popconfirm](components/Popconfirm.md) | Popconfirm: a lightweight confirmation that pops up next to its trigger, for actions with a small impact that still need confirming (such as removing one access grant). | Removing a member, revoking access, deleting a draft row |
| [Popover](components/Popover.md) | Popover: a floating card next to its trigger with a title and richer content than a tooltip, such as details of a person, a short form or a few actions. | Details of a person or a file on hover, a short form next to a button, filters |
| [Progress](components/Progress.md) | Progress shows how far a task has come, as a line (default) or a ring (`variant="circle"`); the value uses tabular numbers. | Upload and import progress, storage usage, completion of a profile |
| [Skeleton](components/Skeleton.md) | A skeleton: a placeholder shaped like the final content while part of the page loads. | Partial loading in message lists, cards and panels |
| [useConfirmDanger](components/useConfirmDanger.md) | Danger confirmation: returns `confirm(options)`, which resolves to true when the user confirms. | Irreversible actions such as deleting, clearing data, transferring ownership or disbanding a team |
| [useMessage](components/useMessage.md) | Messages: short notices about the result of an action; choose `success`, `error`, `info`, `warning` or `loading` by meaning, and use `undoable` to offer "Undo" for reversible actions. | Results of actions such as saving or deleting; "Undo" for reversible actions (archiving, removing, moving to the trash) |

| [useHotkeys](components/useHotkeys.md) | Registers a keyboard shortcut for as long as the component is mounted, such as `useHotkeys('mod+k', openPalette, { description: 'Search' })`. | Global shortcuts such as opening a command palette, toggling a sidebar or showing shortcut help; shortcuts of an open panel |

## Design tokens

The CSS variables of the theme, for the few places where an application writes its own CSS: [tokens](tokens.md).

## Relationship with Ant Design

Ant Design is only used internally: forms, inputs, overlays and similar components are implemented with it, but their props, values and callbacks are declared by vellum-ui, and no antd type is part of the public API. Their appearance comes from the theme. antd can therefore be upgraded, or a component reimplemented, without breaking applications. Applications do not need to, and should not, import antd directly.

Concepts of antd that duplicate the components of this library are merged under one name: `Tag` → Pill, `Badge` → CountBadge / StatusDot, `Card` → Panel, `Space` → Stack / Inline, `Empty` → EmptyState, `Spin` → Loading; `Avatar` is the library's own letter avatar. `Layout`, `Menu` and `Result` are not exported.

The library only provides general-purpose components: business terms do not appear in their names or props. Build components for business data in your application from these components.

Machine-readable documentation data in both languages (generated from the same source): [`components.json`](../components.json), imported as `vellum-ui/docs/components.json`.
